CO_Detector.label: CO Detector
CO_Detector.description: This is an alarm that should be raised if the sensor detects a higher than threshold CO level.

CO_Sensor_Location_Tag.label: CO Sensor Location Tag
CO_Sensor_Location_Tag.description: Verbose identification of the location of the CO sensor.

Ambient_CO_Value.label: Ambient CO Value
Ambient_CO_Value.description: CO value (in ppm) received for the area.

CO_Value.label: CO Value
CO_Value.description: Last or Current Measured CO Value (in ppm) from the Sensor.

Min_CO_Range_Value.label: Min CO Range Value
Min_CO_Range_Value.description: The minimum value that can be measured by the sensor (in ppm).

Max_CO_Range_Value.label: Max CO Range Value
Max_CO_Range_Value.description: The maximum value that can be measured by the sensor.

CO_Detection_Accuracy.label: CO Detection Accuracy
CO_Detection_Accuracy.description: Indicate range of the accuracy for the temperature Sensor.

Minimum_Measured_CO_Value.label: Minimum Measured CO Value
Minimum_Measured_CO_Value.description: The minimum CO value (in ppm) measured by the sensor since power ON or reset.

Maximum_Measured_CO_Value.label: Maximum Measured CO Value
Maximum_Measured_CO_Value.description: The maximum CO value measured (in ppm) by the sensor since power ON or reset

Upper_CO_Threshold.label: Upper CO Threshold
Upper_CO_Threshold.description: Indicate the Upper threshold for the CO Value (in ppm).

Alarm_loudness.label: Alarm loudness
Alarm_loudness.description: Indicate the loudness of the alarm.

Latitude.label: Latitude
Latitude.description: The decimal notation of latitude, e.g. -43.5723 (World Geodetic System 1984).

Longitude.label: Longitude
Longitude.description: The decimal notation of longitude, e.g. 153.21760 (World Geodetic System 1984).

Altitude.label: Altitude
Altitude.description: Altitude above sea level in meters.

Reset.label: Reset
Reset.description: Reset the "CO" object related parameters to default
